description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeJobController class, which manages employee job-related views and data in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods to retrieve various service objects for job titles, categories, company structure, employment status, and location, and prepares data for rendering employee job details with permission checks.

classes.name: EmployeeJobController
classes.description: Controller class for managing employee job information, including rendering data and permissions related to employee job details.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of JobTitleService, instantiated if not already.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of JobCategoryService, instantiated if not already.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CompanyStructureService, instantiated if not already.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EmploymentStatusService, instantiated if not already.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LocationService, instantiated if not already.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets data and permissions in the component before rendering the employee job view, based on the employee number from the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Provides data groups required for capability permission checks.
